description: This file defines the NotUnary class in the Twig template engine, representing a unary 'not' operation node within Twig's expression syntax tree.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Unary\NotUnary
classes.description: A class representing the logical negation (not) unary operation node within Twig's expression tree, extending AbstractUnary.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the raw '!' operator to be used in compiling the expression, indicating logical negation.
